scope_gate.notes: Clean-file experiment. Nextdoor PROHIBITS payday-loan ads and RESTRICTS 'debt services'; position strictly as LEGAL REPRESENTATION (attorneys who make collectors validate the debt), never as debt settlement/relief or a 'reduce what you owe by X%' product. Get WRITTEN sign-off from Nextdoor ad review on (a) attorney-advertising eligibility and (b) legal-services (not debt-services) classification BEFORE any spend.

campaigns.name: Credo Legal — Validation Leads (Nextdoor)
campaigns.attribution: Native form has NO destination URL, so it is NOT UTM-tagged. Attribute by (a) ad name carrying the same cluster / ad-direction tokens, (b) a hidden form field stamping campaign + cluster, and (c) Nextdoor Pixel + CAPI. See lead-gen-form-spec.md.
campaigns.notes: Recommended primary for a sensitive, real-name feed: private, pre-filled from verified neighbor data, no click-off.

campaigns.name: Credo Legal — Validation Traffic (Nextdoor)
campaigns.attribution: Destination URL carries the UTM set below; Nextdoor also appends its own click id `ndclid` — preserve it. No Google-style tracking-template / final-url-suffix field; params are baked directly into each destination URL. No shorteners.
campaigns.notes: Secondary path for the fuller LP experience. Same ad groups / ads / creatives as the lead-gen campaign.

utm_scheme.conventions: all lowercase; hyphens inside a token; underscores only between the structural parts of utm_campaign; one utm_medium value forever.
utm_scheme.click_id: ndclid (Nextdoor-appended on the destination URL — never strip or reorder)

targeting_defaults.geo: United States, scoped to New York and New Jersey only (per launch scope). Broad-geo first, then narrow — many members leave age/gender blank and get silently excluded by over-restriction.
targeting_defaults.demographic: Skews homeowner, 35+, household income $75K+, suburban. Layer homeownership / income / age lightly; do NOT target under-18; do NOT assert or imply protected attributes (Nextdoor restricted-financial rule).
targeting_defaults.audiences: Upload existing clients to EXCLUDE; build lookalikes from best customers; retarget Google/Meta LP visitors via the Nextdoor Pixel.

budget_bidding.monthly_test_line: ~$5,000/mo, disciplined test (Nextdoor is a secondary/unproven channel for this vertical).
budget_bidding.bid_to_daily_ratio: Keep 5-10x bid-to-daily-budget so delivery is not starved (e.g. $10 bid -> $75-100/day). Start higher to learn, then taper.

tracking.pixel: Nextdoor Universal Pixel on every LP (via tag manager) + Conversion API (CAPI) server-side. Events: lead, purchase, custom.
tracking.call_tracking: Pixel MISSES phone-call leads — wire a dedicated per-cluster DNI call number so calls are attributed.
tracking.crm: Zapier (or Hightouch) auto-routes captured leads into the CRM/stub.
tracking.retention: Nextdoor keeps 30 days of report data — export before the window closes.

compliance.new_jersey: Include responsible attorney's name (Jack [CONFIRM full name]) and firm contact (mailing address, phone, email). No pre-filing requirement.
compliance.new_york: Additionally: (a) 'Attorney Advertising' label, (b) attorney (Jack) PRE-APPROVAL of every ad before it goes live, (c) AI-generated-content disclosure. All copy is AI-drafted -> humanize + Jack's review before launch.
compliance.universal_footer: Crēdo Legal. The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.
compliance.results_disclaimer: Prior outcomes don't guarantee similar results.
compliance.creative_exclusions: Bold red-gesture creative stays OUT of Nextdoor (reads aggressive/salesy; the community downvotes it). No 9:16 (Nextdoor uses 1:1 and 1.91:1). Logos hurt CTR here (-14%) — keep brand present but understated while still visible per policy.
